## About

A typical social or event manifesto card: one graphic clip of three text layers and an
underline. Each line has its own layer keyframes, opacity 0 to 100 and scale 160 to 100 over a
third of a second, staggered by 0.6 s, with an Ease In on the landing keyframe so the words slam
and settle. The underline grows with Scale Width, which only applies once the layer's Uniform
Scale is turned off.
